text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, that was terrible! You're garbage at
this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you don't need to apologize all
seriously or
whatever. I was the one who
wanted one...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And come to think of it, my room is
pretty messy.
There'd be nowhere to put
another plushie. So,
actually, I'm glad
you didn't get one.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm starving now. Buy me some
ramen and
we'll call it even. Deal? Deal!
Let's go!
